newsitem.title: UK: Selfcare says will win Enviromed fight.
newsitem.headline: Selfcare says will win Enviromed fight.

text.p: U.S. diagnostics company Selfcare Inc said on Thursday it was increasingly confident of succeeding in its attempt to replace the board of embattled British healthcare group Enviromed Plc.
In a letter to shareholders, Selfcare chief executive officer Ron Zwanziger said he had contacted other institutions.
"Additionally a number of shareholders have contacted me personally to let me know they plan to vote for the resolutions. We strongly believe we will win," Zwanziger said.
Selfcare has called an extraordinary shareholders' meeting to vote on replacing the board on January 17.
The U.S. company, which controls nearly 29 percent of the voting shares in Enviromed, already has the backing of BIB Holdings (Bermuda) Ltd, which holds just under eight percent.
Enviromed, which produces specialist enzymes and is developing a number of diagnostic devices, has accused Selfcare of trying to take it over by the back door.

Zwanziger said that if Selfcare gained control of Enviromed it would move quickly to "restore profitablity and cash flow" to the company, which has seen it share price crumble over the past two years.

Zwanziger said the strategy would focus on developing the enzyme and biochemical business Biozyme, injecting funds by cutting costs elsewhere and selling off those parts of the diagnostics business "which are not capable of contributing to shareholder value."
